directDependencies.name: pitchy
directDependencies.purpose: McLeod pitch detection inside the realtime Web Worker
directDependencies.distributionForm: Bundled ESM JavaScript in the local Web Worker
directDependencies.alternativesConsidered: A new independent McLeod implementation would avoid a dependency but add DSP correctness and maintenance risk; pitchfinder was rejected because its current package metadata declares GPL-3.0. Pitchy matches ADR-003 and is isolated behind the CyberMuse analyzer adapter.
directDependencies.copyright: Copyright (c) Ian Johnson; retain the upstream MIT license text.
directDependencies.requiredNotices: Include pitchy and fft.js MIT copyright/license material in M6 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
directDependencies.securityAndMaintenance: Exact ESM release and registry integrity are locked. Version 4.1.0 was published 2024-01-04 and remains latest as reviewed 2026-08-25; the low release cadence is accepted for this small isolated DSP dependency, with deterministic fixtures guarding replacement.
